instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 3T neutral oil; 1 onion; 1 red onion; 2 cloves of garlic; 4cm ginger; 1 red pepper; 1t curry powder; 250g green beans; 4 tomatoes; 200ml fish broth; 200ml coconut milk; 400g fish fillet (white fish). Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Cut onions, tomato, garlic and fish.

Heat oil on a wok and sauté the onion and garlic Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly. For this stovetop step, start over medium heat and lower it if the food browns before the center cooks.
Add beans, tomato, broth and spices and boil for 6 minutes
Add coconut milk, fish and pepper (whole) and boil for an additional 6 minutes.

Before serving, check uncooked fish or shrimp with a food thermometer: it must reach 145°F (63°C). Fish should separate easily into flakes; shrimp should be opaque and firm. Continue cooking and recheck if needed.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Thijs Wester
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil green beans for 10 minutes
2. Cut onions, tomato, garlic and fish.
3. Heat oil on a wok and sauté the onion and garlic
4. Add beans, tomato, broth and spices and boil for 6 minutes
5. Add coconut milk, fish and pepper (whole) and boil for an additional 6 minutes.
